title: Observe the prescribed public signs while the lesion remains unclean
original_audience: Person with a diagnosed unclean skin lesion
context_note: The affected person’s clothing is loosened, the head is uncovered, the mouth is covered, and the person is called unclean. Verse 44 separately names the priest who declares uncleanness. The Saints text does not say that the person must personally cry out.
verse_text: [13:45] And he that has leprosy, in whom the lesion is, shall have his garments loosened and his head uncovered, and shall put a covering about his mouth, and shall be called unclean;
maimonides: P112: The afflicted person rends garments, bares head, covers lip, announces uncleanness

title: A person with the unclean lesion: dwell apart outside the camp while the lesion persists
original_audience: Person with a diagnosed unclean skin lesion
verse_text: [13:46] all the days in which the lesion is upon him, being unclean, he shall be unclean; he shall dwell apart; his dwelling shall be outside the camp.

title: The recovering person: remain outside your house for seven days after camp re-entry
original_audience: Recovering person who has reentered the camp
verse_text: [14:8] And the person who has been cleansed shall wash his garments, shave off all his hair, bathe in water, and be clean. Afterward he shall enter the camp, but he shall remain outside his house for seven days.

title: Present the prescribed eighth-day purification offerings and oil, with the poverty substitutions
original_audience: Person completing purification from a lesion
verse_text: [14:10] And on the eighth day he shall take two unblemished year-old lambs, one unblemished year-old sheep, three tenths of fine flour mixed with oil for a sacrifice, and one kotyle of oil, [14:11] and the priest who performs the cleansing shall present the person being cleansed and these things before the Lord at the entrance of the Tent of Testimony.
maimonides: P77: The healed metzora brings his purification offerings

title: Determine whether the house lesion is clean or unclean by the applicable signs
verse_text: [14:36] And the priest shall command that the house be emptied before he enters to examine the lesion, so that nothing in the house becomes unclean. Afterward the priest shall enter to examine the house. [14:37] And he shall examine the lesion in the walls of the house, greenish or fiery-red hollows whose appearance is lower than the walls, [14:38] and the priest shall leave the house, go to its door, and isolate the house for seven days. [14:39] And the priest shall return on the seventh day, and examine the house; and, behold, if the lesion has not spread in the walls of the house,
maimonides: P103: Observe the laws of skin-disease impurity in houses

title: Demolish the house with the persistent lesion
original_audience: Persons carrying out the ruling on the affected house
verse_text: [14:45] And they shall demolish the house, and carry its timbers, its stones, and all its dust outside the city into an unclean place.

title: Observe uncleanness until evening after entering the isolated house
verse_text: [14:46] And whosoever enters the house during any of the days it is isolated shall be unclean until evening.

title: Apply the stated uncleanness periods and contact rules for bodily discharges
original_audience: Israelites with a bodily discharge and those affected by contact
verse_text: [15:2] Speak unto the sons of Israel, and you shall say unto them: If any man has a flow from his body, his flow is unclean. [15:3] And this is the law of his uncleanness: discharging seed from his body through the flow by which his body has become stopped up, this is his uncleanness in him; all the days of the flow of his body, in which his body has become stopped up through the flow, are his uncleanness. [15:4] Every bed on which the man with a seminal discharge lies is unclean, and every article on which the man with a seminal discharge sits shall be unclean.
maimonides: P104: Observe the impurity laws of a man with a discharge (zav)

title: Remain unclean until evening after the specified discharge contact
original_audience: Persons with the specified contact involving a discharge
verse_text: [15:5] And whosoever touches his bed shall wash his garments, bathe in water, and be unclean until evening. [15:6] And whosoever sits on an article on which the man with a seminal discharge has sat shall wash his garments, bathe in water, and be unclean until evening. [15:7] And whosoever touches the skin of the man with a seminal discharge shall wash his garments, bathe in water, and be unclean until evening. [15:8] If the man with a seminal discharge spits on someone clean, that person shall wash his garments, bathe in water, and be unclean until evening.

title: Treat a donkey saddle ridden by a man with the specified discharge as unclean until evening
original_audience: Israel, particularly users of equipment ridden by the man with the stated discharge
context_note: Verse 9 assigns a separate ritual status to a saddle ridden by the man. The status of bedding and persons who touch or carry contaminated objects is treated separately.
verse_text: [15:9] And any donkey saddle on which the man with a seminal discharge mounts shall be unclean until evening.

title: Count seven clear days after the specified discharge ceases
original_audience: Israelite man recovering from the stated discharge
verse_text: [15:13] When the man with a seminal discharge is cleansed from his flow, he shall count seven days for his cleansing, wash his garments, bathe his body in water, and be clean.

title: Bring the two prescribed birds to the priest after recovery from the discharge
original_audience: Israelite recovering from the stated discharge
verse_text: [15:14] And on the eighth day he shall take two turtledoves or two young pigeons, bring them before the Lord to the doors of the Tent of Testimony, and give them unto the priest. [15:15] And the priest shall prepare them, one for sin and one for a whole burnt offering. The priest shall make atonement for him before the Lord for his flow.
maimonides: P74: A man cured of a discharge brings his offering

title: Observe uncleanness until evening after the stated seminal emission or intercourse
original_audience: Man with the emission, or both participants in the stated intercourse
verse_text: [15:16] And if a man has an emission of semen, he shall bathe his whole body in water and be unclean until evening.
maimonides: P105: Observe the impurity of a seminal emission

title: Wash semen-contaminated garments or skins and keep them unclean until evening
original_audience: Persons responsible for contaminated garments or skins
verse_text: [15:17] And every garment and every skin on which there is semen shall be washed with water and be unclean until evening.

title: Observe the seven-day menstrual status and its stated contact consequences
original_audience: Israelite women during menstruation and those who have the specified contact
context_note: The text treats menstruation, bedding and seats, contact, and intercourse as distinct situations. It specifies their respective ritual statuses and any washing required. The prohibition of intercourse in Leviticus 18:19 remains a separate provision.
verse_text: [15:19] And if a woman has a flow of blood, her flow shall be in her body; she shall remain in her menstrual discharge for seven days. Whosoever touches her shall be unclean until evening, [15:20] and everything on which she lies during her menstrual discharge shall be unclean, and everything on which she sits shall be unclean. [15:21] And whosoever touches her bed shall wash his garments, bathe his body in water, and be unclean until evening. [15:22] And whosoever touches any article on which she sits shall wash his garments, bathe in water, and be unclean until evening. [15:23] If, while she is on her bed or on the article on which she sits, he touches her, he shall be unclean until evening. [15:24] If anyone lies with her and her uncleanness comes upon him, he shall be unclean for seven days, and every bed on which he lies shall be unclean.
maimonides: P99: Observe the impurity laws of a menstruating woman (niddah)

title: Treat a prolonged or irregular flow of blood as menstrual uncleanness
original_audience: a woman with a prolonged flow, and Israel
context_note: the Lord through Moses and Aaron addresses a woman with a prolonged flow, and Israel in this passage.
verse_text: [15:25] And if a woman has a flow of blood for many days outside the time of her menstrual discharge, or if she also has a flow after her menstrual discharge, all the days of her unclean flow shall be like the days of her menstrual discharge; she shall be unclean. [15:26] And every bed on which she lies during all the days of her flow shall be like the bed of her menstrual discharge, and every article on which she sits shall be unclean, as in the uncleanness of her menstrual discharge.
maimonides: P106: Observe the impurity laws of a woman with irregular flow (zavah)

title: Count seven days after a prolonged flow ceases before cleansing
original_audience: a woman healed of a prolonged flow
context_note: the Lord through Moses and Aaron addresses a woman healed of a prolonged flow in this passage.
verse_text: [15:28] When she is cleansed from her flow, she shall count seven days, and afterward she shall be cleansed.

title: Bring two turtledoves or pigeons to the priest on the eighth day
original_audience: a woman healed of a prolonged flow
context_note: the Lord through Moses and Aaron addresses a woman healed of a prolonged flow in this passage.
verse_text: [15:29] And on the eighth day she shall take two turtledoves or two young pigeons and bring them unto the priest at the entrance of the Tent of Testimony.
maimonides: P75: A woman cured of an irregular flow brings her offering

title: High priest: do not enter within the veil at unauthorized times
verse_text: [16:2] And the Lord said unto Moses: Speak unto Aaron your brother, and let him not enter at all times into the holy place within the veil, before the propitiatory cover which is upon the ark of testimony, so that he does not die; for I will appear in a cloud above the propitiatory cover.

maimonides: P49: Perform the Day of Atonement service

original_audience: Anyone other than the high priest

title: The anointed successor high priest: perform the prescribed annual atonement for the sanctuary, priests and people
verse_text: [16:32] The priest whom they anoint and whose hands they consecrate to serve as priest after his father shall make atonement. He shall put on the linen robe, a holy robe, [16:33] and he shall make atonement for the Holy of Holies, and for the Tent of Testimony and the altar shall he make atonement; and for the priests and for the whole congregation shall he make atonement. [16:34] And this shall be an everlasting statute unto you, to make atonement for the sons of Israel from all their sins; it shall be done once in the year, as the Lord directed Moses.
maimonides: P49: Perform the Day of Atonement service

title: Bring the prescribed sacrifices to God's appointed sanctuary
verse_text: [17:3] Any person of the sons of Israel or of the resident foreigners attached to you who slaughters a calf, sheep, or goat in the camp, or slaughters it outside the camp, [17:4] and does not bring it unto the door of the Tent of Testimony, to prepare it as a whole burnt offering or an offering of deliverance acceptable unto the Lord for a sweet savour; and whosoever slaughters outside, and does not bring it unto the door of the Tent of Testimony, so as not to present a gift unto the Lord before the tent of the Lord: blood shall be reckoned unto that man; he has poured out blood; that soul shall be destroyed from among his people. [17:5] This is so that the sons of Israel may bring up their sacrifices, which they themselves slaughter in the plains; they shall bring them unto the Lord, to the doors of the Tent of Testimony, unto the priest, and sacrifice them as a sacrifice of deliverance unto the Lord.
maimonides: P84: Offer all sacrifices only at the chosen place
N90: Do not slaughter sacrificial animals outside the Sanctuary court

title: Do not sacrifice to the vain or demonic objects of worship

title: Do not eat blood
original_audience: Native Israelites and resident foreigners attached to Israel
context_note: Leviticus states the prohibition directly for Israel and resident foreigners and gives its covenant consequence. C0019 principally records the earlier Genesis 9:4 charge to Noah’s household. It does not supply an itemized Mosaic Law for the distinct audience.
verse_text: [17:10] And any man of the sons of Israel, or of the resident foreigners attached unto you, who eats any blood: I will set My face against the soul that eats the blood, and destroy him from among his people. [17:11] For the life of all flesh is its blood, and I have given it unto you upon the altar to make atonement for your lives; for its blood shall make atonement in place of the life. [17:12] Therefore I have said unto the sons of Israel: No soul among you shall eat blood; and the resident foreigner attached unto you shall not eat blood. [17:14] For the life of all flesh is its blood; and I said unto the sons of Israel: You shall eat no blood of any flesh, for the life of all flesh is its blood; whosoever eats it shall be destroyed.
maimonides: N184: Do not eat blood

title: Cover the hunted animal's blood with earth
original_audience: Israelite or resident foreigner hunting an edible animal or bird

maimonides: P147: Cover the blood of slaughtered wild animals and birds

title: Carcass eaters must wash and bathe and remain unclean until evening
original_audience: Native Israelites and resident foreigners who eat an animal that died or was taken by wild beasts
verse_text: [17:15] And every soul, whether among the natives or among the resident foreigners, that eats an animal which has died or has been taken by wild beasts, shall wash his garments and bathe in water, and be unclean until evening, and shall be clean. [17:16] But if he does not wash his garments and does not bathe his body in water, he shall bear his lawless deed.
